subject: Russia and Ukraine exchanged remains of over 550 fallen soldiers, lawmaker says
posts: Amidst the ongoing conflict, a grim humanitarian exchange offers a rare moment of cooperation. Russia-Ukraine body exchange. Evidence: Humanitarian duty, Conflict reality, Respect for dead. #Aletheia #Humanitarian

State Duma lawmaker Shamsail Saraliyev confirmed the return of 522 Ukrainian and 33 Russian bodies. This follows previous exchanges mediated by the UAE, marking a rare instance of humanitarian cooperation since 2022.
